entities.name: Alejandro Muñoz-Alonso
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alejandro Muñoz-Alonso was a Spanish politician. A member of the People's Party he served in the Congress of Deputies between 1989 and 2000 and in the Senate between 2000 and 2015. From 2004 to 2006 he was appointed Vice President of the Senate.
